display.purpose: Hero titles and large metrics at the system's medium-weight ceiling.

headline.purpose: Section titles and major plate headings.

body.purpose: Readable explanatory prose in Inter Tight.

label.purpose: Uppercase kickers, captions, state labels, indices, and metadata.

control.purpose: Compact buttons and interactive controls at medium weight.

code.purpose: Code, diffs, terminal output, and structured data.

shadows.name: resting-plate
shadows.purpose: Minimal ambient separation for white structural surfaces on the gray canvas.

shadows.name: floating-tool
shadows.purpose: Two-layer lift for fixed review chrome only.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active controls move by translateY(1px) scale(0.98).

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Default background and color state transition for static HTML controls.

motion.name: pop-spring
motion.purpose: React pop-in motion; exits use stiffness 380 and damping 28.

components.name: Pill Control
components.description: The default compact action for inspection and view controls.
components.css: .ds-pill-control { min-height: 2.25rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ve-panel-strong, #f6f6f6); padding: .5rem .75rem; color: var(--ve-heading, #292929); font: 500 .875rem/1 "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, color 160ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pill-control:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ve-heading, #292929) 8%, transparent); } .ds-pill-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #3ba6f1 52%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pill-control:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); }

components.name: Callout Plate
components.description: A calm white surface for a focused explanatory note.
components.html:
SOURCE CONTRACT

MDX is the editable source; standalone HTML is the generated artifact.
components.css: .ds-callout-plate { border: 1px solid var(--ve-rule, rgb(41 41 41 / .12)); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--ve-panel, #fff); padding: 1.25rem; color: var(--ve-text, rgb(41 41 41 / .92)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .06); corner-shape: squircle; } .ds-callout-label { margin: 0 0 .75rem; color: var(--ve-muted, #6d6d6d); font: 400 .6875rem/1.25 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .13em; } .ds-callout-copy { margin: 0; max-width: 58ch; font: 400 1rem/1.6 "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-callout-plate:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #3ba6f1 52%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pipeline Step
components.description: A numbered process card with restrained mono metadata and an editorial title.
components.html:
01

Author source

Write compact MDX or TSX that stays easy to inspect and revise.
components.css: .ds-pipeline-step { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid var(--ve-rule, rgb(41 41 41 / .12)); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--ve-panel, #fff); padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .06); corner-shape: squircle; } .ds-pipeline-index { color: var(--ve-muted, #6d6d6d); font: 400 .75rem/1.25 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-pipeline-title { margin: 1rem 0 0; color: var(--ve-heading, #292929); font: 500 1.25rem/1.2 "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pipeline-copy { margin: .75rem 0 0; color: var(--ve-muted, #6d6d6d); font: 400 .875rem/1.5 "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Decision Matrix
components.description: A locally scrollable comparison table with mono headers and hairline rows.
components.css: .ds-matrix-shell { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--ve-rule, rgb(41 41 41 / .12)); border-radius: 26px; background: var(--ve-panel, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .06); corner-shape: squircle; } .ds-matrix { width: 100%; min-width: 560px; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--ve-text, rgb(41 41 41 / .92)); font: 400 .875rem/1.5 "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-matrix th { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ve-rule, rgb(41 41 41 / .12)); background: var(--ve-panel-strong, #f6f6f6); padding: .75rem 1rem; color: var(--ve-muted, #6d6d6d); font: 500 .75rem/1.25 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-matrix td { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ve-rule, rgb(41 41 41 / .12)); padding: 1rem; } .ds-matrix tbody tr:nth-child(odd) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ve-heading, #292929) 4%, transparent); } .ds-matrix tbody tr:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ve-accent, #305dde) 7%, transparent); }

components.name: Risk Card
components.description: A labeled status card where color supports, but never replaces, the risk label.
components.html:
MEDIUM

Wide content

Signal: the page root scrolls sideways.

Mitigation: keep overflow inside the inspection surface.
components.css: .ds-risk-card { border: 1px solid var(--ve-rule, rgb(41 41 41 / .12)); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--ve-panel, #fff); padding: 1.25rem; color: var(--ve-text, rgb(41 41 41 / .92)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .06); corner-shape: squircle; } .ds-risk-level { margin: 0; color: var(--ve-warn, #a16207); font: 400 .6875rem/1.25 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .16em; } .ds-risk-title { margin: .75rem 0 0; color: var(--ve-heading, #292929); font: 500 1.125rem/1.3 "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-risk-copy { margin: .75rem 0 0; color: var(--ve-muted, #6d6d6d); font: 400 .875rem/1.5 "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-risk-copy strong { color: var(--ve-text, rgb(41 41 41 / .92)); font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: A compact inverse inspection surface for source and generated output.
components.css: .ds-code-block { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #ededed 14%, transparent); border-radius: 26px; background: var(--ve-code-bg, #191919); color: var(--ve-code-text, #ededed); } .ds-code-caption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #ededed 14%, transparent); padding: .75rem 1rem; color: var(--ve-code-muted, #969696); font: 400 .75rem/1.25 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-code-content { margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; padding: 1rem; font: 400 .875rem/1.7 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-code-accent { color: var(--ve-code-accent, #296ff0); } .ds-code-block:focus-within { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #3ba6f1 52%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Flow Diagram
components.description: A clean, unpatterned diagram where blue marks only the focal path.
components.css: .ds-flow-shell { margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--ve-rule, rgb(41 41 41 / .12)); border-radius: 26px; background: var(--ve-panel, #fff); padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .06); corner-shape: squircle; } .ds-flow-svg { display: block; width: 100%; min-width: 520px; background: var(--ve-diagram-bg, #f6f6f6); } .ds-flow-node { fill: var(--ve-node-bg, #fff); stroke: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ve-heading, #292929) 14%, transparent); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-flow-node-accent { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ve-accent, #305dde) 7%, transparent); stroke: var(--ve-accent, #305dde); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-flow-label { fill: var(--ve-heading, #292929); font: 500 11px "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 1px; text-anchor: middle; } .ds-flow-path { fill: none; stroke: var(--ve-accent, #305dde); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; }

components.name: Diagram Label Chip
components.description: A compact mono connector label used in responsive diagram stacks.
components.css: .ds-diagram-chip { display: inline-flex; max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--ve-rule, rgb(41 41 41 / .12)); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ve-diagram-bg, #f6f6f6); padding: .24rem .45rem; color: var(--ve-heading, #292929); font: 400 .68rem/1.3 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-diagram-chip:hover { border-color: var(--ve-accent, #305dde); color: var(--ve-accent, #305dde); } .ds-diagram-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #3ba6f1 52%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiz Option
components.description: A full-width answer control with explicit text feedback and semantic support color.
components.css: .ds-quiz-option { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.25rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: .75rem; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--ve-ok, #047857); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ve-ok, #047857) 12%, transparent); padding: .75rem; color: var(--ve-text, rgb(41 41 41 / .92)); font: 500 .875rem/1.2 "Inter Tight", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, transform 100ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-quiz-choice { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-height: 2rem; border: 1px solid var(--ve-rule, rgb(41 41 41 / .12)); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ve-muted, #6d6d6d); font-family: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-quiz-result { color: var(--ve-ok, #047857); font: 400 .75rem/1 "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-quiz-option:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ve-ok, #047857) 16%, transparent); } .ds-quiz-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #3ba6f1 52%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-quiz-option:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); }

narrative.overview:
The Quiet Instrument treats every explainer as a precise working artifact: calm enough to study, composed enough to trust, and visually articulate without performing for attention. A quiet gray canvas holds a small number of generous white plates; near-black ink, disciplined spacing, and a single restrained blue carry the hierarchy.

The system is editorial and tool-native rather than decorative. It favors readable measures, immediate chrome, and self-contained technical regions that remain useful from mobile to desktop. OA Design is the default reference for interaction and surface grammar, while the existing visual-explainer token contract keeps every export portable.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet gray canvas with white continuous-curvature plates.
Near-black ink with restrained blue reserved for focal action and path.
Inter Tight hierarchy capped at medium weight, with Geist Mono for technical labels.
Generous whitespace, hairline rules, and only two established depth levels.
Responsive stacking and locally scrollable dense regions on a clean, undecorated canvas.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the primary blue only for focal action, navigation, selection, or a diagram's focal path; never distribute it as decoration.

rules.name: The Labeled Status Rule
rules.body: Semantic color may support text, dots, or paths, but a visible label must also communicate the status.

rules.name: The Medium Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Keep display and heading text at 500 or below; use scale, spacing, and ink opacity—not heavy weight—to build hierarchy.

rules.name: The Mono Is Metadata Rule
rules.body: Reserve Geist Mono for code, labels, indices, and tabular technical detail; prose remains in Inter Tight.

rules.name: The Local Overflow Rule
rules.body: Dense technical content may scroll inside its own surface; the artifact page itself never scrolls horizontally.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Limit Rule
rules.body: Use only the resting plate shadow or the floating tool shadow; do not invent intermediate elevations.

rules.name: The Squircle Plate Rule
rules.body: Use continuous-curvature corners for major white plates and cards, with the established radius stepping down as the component becomes smaller.

dos: Do build hierarchy with whitespace, scale, and ink opacity before adding color or weight.
Do group related information into a small number of generous white squircle plates on the quiet gray canvas.
Do keep headings at medium weight or lighter and reserve Geist Mono for technical structure.
Do stack responsive layouts and keep overflow local to dense inspection surfaces.
Do preserve visible focus, readable touch targets, browser zoom, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add decorative grid, dot-matrix, blueprint, graph-paper, scanline, paper, or terminal backgrounds.
Don't use decorative gradients, glass panels, generic SaaS card grids, or repeated icon-card compositions.
Don't distribute the primary blue across secondary decoration or allow color to communicate status alone.
Don't invent heavier heading weights, intermediate shadows, or extra elevation levels.
Don't treat named presets as color swaps; typography, rhythm, motifs, and composition must remain systemic.
